error[ZBX-E0526]: there is no zbx.lock for this project
  while  reading zbx.lock
  cause  there is no zbx.lock in '/home/alice/project' or any directory above it
  dir    /home/alice/project
  fix    pull an image from the project directory; that makes the lock:   zbx pull alpine:3.20
  more   zbx explain E0526
